decks.title: Data Structures
decks.description: Arrays, stacks, queues, trees and graphs

questions.question: What is the time complexity of accessing an element in an array by index?
What data structure follows the LIFO principle?
questions.answer: A stack. LIFO means Last In, First Out.

questions.question: What data structure follows the FIFO principle?
questions.answer: A queue. FIFO means First In, First Out.

questions.question: What is the average time complexity of searching in a hash table?
questions.answer: O(1), assuming a good hash function and limited collisions.

questions.question: What is the time complexity of binary search?
What is the worst-case time complexity of bubble sort?
What technique does merge sort use?
What is Big O notation used for?
questions.answer: It describes how an algorithm's time or space requirements grow as the input size increases.

questions.question: What is a primary key?
questions.answer: A column or set of columns that uniquely identifies each row in a table.

questions.question: What is the purpose of database normalization?
questions.answer: To reduce data redundancy and improve data integrity.
